chapter: Looking back and the lean years
title: Buying houses in California and the 400 Club with Happy Comer
summary: He twice bought a house; the 400 Club paid $450 a week but lasted six weeks, though he had a magnificent band.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: You even at one point bought a house in California - didn't you?

And, once I thought I had it made; I went to the 400 Club, I had a hell of a band -- and every-thing and he said - you got a steady job here; I'll give you so much a week - $450 a week - just for you and every-thing was fine - go along fine; it lasted the most six weeks.
That went on a little longer than that - didn't it?
-- a couple of times we went back, but I was still putting across; there was just no steady job anywhere.
Where a guy could say - well, okay - I'll give you a contract for two years --
Was that the band that had McCracken and Lincoln?
And Nappy LaMare and Don Owens.
